dialogues.speaker: Arnim
dialogues.text: This section here... and this bit here... I feel that more romantic elements need to be added here to allow the readers to experience the emotions within.

dialogues.speaker: Hagihara
dialogues.text: Mr. Arnim, please allow me to remind you that adding "romantic descriptions" does not mean adding a few personal opinions too many to the text.

dialogues.speaker: Hagihara
dialogues.text: We are here to draw inspiration from cultural performances from other lands, not to mutate their stories with our personal sentiments.

dialogues.speaker: Arnim
dialogues.text: Tsk, tsk. What did I expect of a writer of deductive novels — of course you know nothing of poetic beauty.

dialogues.speaker: Arnim
dialogues.text: A poem that is to be recited, whether romantic or ironic, must have pulse with an emotional rhythm.

dialogues.speaker: Hagihara
dialogues.text: ... I have a feeling that you're simply avoiding the crux of the issue here.

dialogues.speaker: Hagihara
dialogues.text: *sigh* If you cannot answer my questions directly, then at least don't add on whatever you please, whenever you please.
